name: Waleed Zafar
title: Mission Critical Director
bio: Waleed Zafar is the Mission Critical Director of XYZ Reality, a leading developer of construction technology solutions that give owners and contractors an accurate and objective way to manage and deliver projects. Waleed joined XYZ Reality as its first employee and has led the deployment of XYZ’s platform across all major projects globally. He partners closely with mission-critical clients to streamline time-to-market and expedite project delivery.
